text: The Fulkerson Prize, awarded for outstanding contributions in discrete mathematics, is jointly sponsored by the Mathematical Optimization Society (MOS) and the American Mathematical Society (AMS). Up to three prizes of $1,500 each are given at each triennial International Symposium of the MOS. Initially, the prizes were funded by a memorial fund established by friends of the late Delbert Ray Fulkerson to promote mathematical excellence in the areas of research he was known for. Currently, the prizes are supported by an endowment managed by the MOS.
